brief.description: Tong is an AI-powered dating simulator and Chrome extension designed for learning Korean, Japanese, and Chinese. It leverages AI-generated NPCs and immersive social scenarios to provide a gamified, open-source language acquisition experience.
campaignGoals: Generate email signups for early access and beta testing
Build a community of open-source contributors and AI enthusiasts
Position Tong as a fun, low-friction alternative to traditional language apps
Showcase the potential of 100% AI-generated game development
contentAngles: Learn a language by flirting with AI-generated NPCs
Behind the scenes: Building a complete game using only AI instructions
Stop memorizing flashcards and start having real conversations
The open-source future of personalized language education
brief.targetAudience: Language learners (Beginner to Intermediate) focused on CJK languages, visual novel fans, and tech-savvy developers interested in AI-driven applications.
